scripts.docker: npm run build && docker rmi $(docker images 'policy-engine') & docker build --tag policy-engine . &  docker run -it --rm -p 8080:80 --name web policy-engine
scripts.client: docker rmi $(docker images 'mock-client') & docker build -f mock/client/Dockerfile --tag mock-client . &  docker run -it --rm -p 8081:80 -v %cd%/mock/client/html:/usr/share/nginx/html mock-client
scripts.demo: webpack --config webpack.demo.js & docker rmi $(docker images 'policy-engine-frontend') & docker build -f mock/demo/Dockerfile -t ga-policy-engine/frontend-demo . &  docker run -it --rm -p 8080:80 --name web ga-policy-engine/frontend-demo
scripts.testing: webpack --config webpack.testing.js & docker rmi $(docker images 'ga-policy-engine') & docker build -f mock/backend/Dockerfile -t ga-policy-engine/frontend-testing . &  docker run -it --rm -p 8080:80 --name web ga-policy-engine/frontend-testing
